name: Banh uot thit nuong
summary: Bánh ướt thịt nướng is a roll you build. Vietnam Tourism uses grilled pork. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article uses grilled beef. Danang Fantasticity does not name the animal.
origin: Hoi An. Vietnam Tourism lists it with the town’s food. The conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, places stalls along the Hoài river.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism stacks grilled pork from lemongrass skewers with salad, herbs, cucumber, and star fruit, wraps them in wet rice paper, and dips them in soybean paste, peanuts, sesame, fish sauce, and chili.
The 4 December 2025 article rolls grilled beef and dips it in a rich, mildly hot peanut-butter sauce.

Danang Fantasticity’s 16 April 2024 essay says hot grilled meat, Trà Quế herbs, green banana, cucumber, and a sauce it calls special. It names a sweet sauce, fragrant meat, chili, and astringent herbs, and does not name the animal.
The 4 September 2024 article says grilled skewers with a little peanut, herbs, and a salty-sweet dip, along the Hoài, and does not name the animal. Keep every account.
where: Stalls along the Hoài river, on the 4 September 2024 article. A house number and the hour are Check on arrival.
